name: TRL
description:
Total Request Live was a television series on MTV that featured popular music videos. TRL was MTV's prime outlet for music videos as the network continued to concentrate on reality-based programming. In addition to music videos, TRL featured daily guests. The show was a popular promotion tool used by musicians, actors, and other celebrities to promote their newest works to the show's target teen demographic.

TRL played the top ten most requested videos of the day, as requested by viewers who voted online for their favorite video. The countdown started with the tenth most requested video and ended with the most requested. As of October 22, 2007, TRL's countdown was based on votes, charts, ringtones, download, radio airplay, and streams, meaning that the most user requested video might not have been the number 1 video. The show generally aired Monday through Thursday for one hour, though the scheduling and length of the show fluctuated over the years. Despite the word "Live" in the title of the show, many episodes were actually pre-recorded.

It was announced on September 15, 2008 that TRL would be shut down and replaced with FNMTV. The special three-hour finale aired on November 16, 2008, at 8 p.m.

videos.overview: It's an Unholy Union when Bam Margera and his fiance drop by the studio.

videos.title: January 30, 2007
videos.overview: Spankin' New Music Week is just around the corner so we take a look back at the best performances of Spankin' New Music Week.

videos.title: January 31, 2007
videos.overview: We bring you TRL Webcam where we let you speak your mind on the videos and what you like.

videos.title: February 1, 2007
videos.overview: Mark your calenders! Spankin' New Music Week: A-List Playlists kicks off Monday, don't miss it!

videos.title: February 5, 2007 (SPANKIN' NEW MUSIC WEEK)
videos.overview: "Idol" beauty Katharine McPhee gives us a song; Gnarls Barkley unveils a brand new video; Lauren, Heidi, AND Audrina come down from "The Hills" for a visit; we're taking a First Look at what The Game's up to; and Jennifer Lopez, herself, is hittin' us on the hip, if you will.

videos.title: February 6, 2007 (SPANKIN' NEW MUSIC WEEK)
videos.overview: Hop aboard Infinity Flight 206 with Fall Out Boy! They're here performing live with labelmates-slash BFF's Gym Class Heroes. Plus, Nas stops by with his new video. Hopefully he'll be resurrecting hip-hop.

videos.title: February 7, 2007 (SPANKIN' NEW MUSIC WEEK)
videos.overview: Watch Lloyd turn it out live. Timbaland and Fergie are in the building with new videos. Ashley Tisdale's stopping by. And Love Angel Music Baby Gwen Stefani's holl'rin' at us via satellite.

videos.title: February 8, 2007 (SPANKIN' NEW MUSIC WEEK)
videos.overview: The Killers bring their latest video! Plus, it's a full house with Akon, who's gonna be performing and premiering a new video. Hilary Duff's debuting a new video too. And Robin Thicke tops it all off like a sweet cherry on a smooth and sexy banana split.

videos.title: February 9, 2007 (SPANKIN' NEW MUSIC WEEK)
videos.overview: Good Charlotte drops by with their brand new video. Plus Oscar-toutin' Three 6 Mafia unveils their newest video too. Miley Cyrus is in the house, and the lovely little Lily Allen's gonna spill some sweetness on stage.

videos.title: February 12, 2007
videos.overview: Co-hostess and indestructable "Heroes" cheerleader Hayden Panettiere helps us introduce California alt-rockers Augustana!

videos.title: February 13, 2007
videos.overview: Watch Damein and the rest of the dudes in the audience sweat as "Desperate Housewives" star Eva Longoria struts her stuff.

videos.title: February 14, 2007
videos.overview: Is she dating Zach Braff? Get your gossip straight when Drew Barrymore comes by with her "Music and Lyrics" co-star, Haley Bennett.

videos.title: February 15, 2007
videos.overview: The parade of ladies continues when super-hottie Eva Mendes stops by to loosen our jaws and give us a sneak peek at "Ghost Rider".

videos.title: February 20, 2007 (KATHARINE MCPHEE WEEK)
videos.overview: The usually hilarious Jim Carrey's here to talk about his definitely-not-funny scary new movie, The Number 23. Don't be afraid, Katharine McPhee will be there to keep you safe!

videos.title: February 21, 2007 (KATHARINE MCPHEE WEEK)
videos.overview: Freeze! Put your hands on your head and step away from the vehicle! The crazy cops of Reno 911 are here! They're gonna lay down the law with co-host Katharine McPhee!

videos.title: February 22, 2007 (KATHARINE MCPHEE WEEK)
videos.overview: Whether you're a brother or whether you're a mother John Travolta's here! And we take a First Look at what's keeping Rich Boy busy. Katharine will have her hands full today-see how she holds up on her 3rd day co-hosting in a row!

videos.title: February 23, 2007 (KATHARINE MCPHEE WEEK)
videos.overview: Katharine McPhee will be co-hosting again! What other reason do you need to tune in?

videos.title: February 26, 2007
videos.overview: We've got new videos from Mrs. Whibly err Avril Lavigne, plus Timbaland's new one, featuring Justin and Nelly Furtado.

videos.title: February 27, 2007
videos.overview: Brace yourself: Jake Gyllenhaal's here to tell us about his freaky film, "Zodiac." And we've got Mims' modest video, "This Is Why I'm Hot."

videos.title: February 28, 2007
videos.overview: Things get heavy with Red Jumpsuit Apparatus' intense new video, "Face Down."

videos.title: March 1, 2007
videos.overview: You'll heart The Fratellis' "Flathead" video and Young Love's "Find a New Way to Dance." Trust us. We know alot about these things.

videos.title: March 5, 2007 (CIARA WEEK)
videos.overview: Prepare for the royal treatment! Perez Hilton, king of celeb goss, dishes the dirt, and Queen Latifah stops by.

videos.title: March 6, 2007 (CIARA WEEK)
videos.overview: Oh. My. God. Chad. Michael. Murray. Is. Here. Can't. Breathe. Properly. Plus, Perez dishes, and we get a First Look at Relient K.

videos.title: March 7, 2007 (CIARA WEEK)
videos.overview: Damien and Ciara count down the hottest videos. Vote for your fave, and tune it to see how the competition heats up.

videos.title: March 8, 2007 (CIARA WEEK)
videos.overview: Oh, Omarion! The cool-as-ice R n' B baller brings his smooth style to the studio. And Cartel gives us a First Look at their latest.

videos.title: March 12, 2007 (NE-YO WEEK)
videos.overview: Rapper Ne-Yo co-hosts, we take a First Look at Joss Stone and Say Anything, and Amy Lee logs onto the show live via webcam.

videos.title: March 13, 2007 (NE-YO WEEK)
videos.overview: Ne-Yo co-hosts, Mark Wahlberg increases blood pressure when he stops by, plus get a First Look at Lloyd and Rich Boy.

videos.title: March 14, 2007 (NE-YO WEEK)
videos.overview: Clear the runway! Hot new R n' B girl group LAX is coming in for a landing. Chris Rock co-hosts and insures a smooth flight.

videos.title: March 15, 2007 (NE-YO WEEK)
videos.overview: Ne-Yo returns for his final co-hosting gig with a First Look at his latest, plus catch up with piano-pop princess Regina Spektor.

videos.title: March 19, 2007
videos.overview: It's all 'bout Nelly Furtado, who returns to TRL to perform live with Timbaland and drop the World Premiere of her new video.

videos.title: March 20, 2007
videos.overview: Joss Stone's in the house, peep Elliott Yamin soulful new video, plus Fergie and Gym Class Heroes performances from Spring Break.

videos.title: March 21, 2007
videos.overview: First Looks fit for a king! Baby Boy Da Prince and Plain White T's show us what's keepin' them busy.

videos.title: March 22, 2007
videos.overview: We'll cop to a First Look at Dashboard Confessional and the crunk kids of Crime Mob. Plus sneak a peek at The Academy Is in Cancun.

videos.title: March 26, 2007 (HILARY DUFF WEEK)
videos.overview: Hilary Duff is here to co-host all we long, plus we've got a premiere of Vanessa Hudgen's latest video.

videos.title: March 27, 2007 (HILARY DUFF WEEK)
videos.overview: Hilary is back for her second day as co-host.

videos.title: March 28, 2007 (HILARY DUFF WEEK)
videos.overview: It's day three of Hilary Duff as co-host.

videos.title: March 29, 2007 (HILARY DUFF WEEK)
videos.overview: It's Hilary's final day as co-host and be sure to vote her video to number one.
